rows.text: wholly-owned U.S. subsidiary Polaris Specialty Chemicals bags an annual business commitment worth USD 11.98 mn (~Rs 111.82 cr) from an undisclosed U.S. customer

signs a **non-binding memorandum of understanding with Spice Lounge Food Works for exclusive Indian offtake of its new food-grade emulsifier line**, indicatively 200 tonnes a month on a take-or-pay basis for five years. Pricing and volumes are not settled and the company says no revenue accrues until a definitive agreement is signed.

signs a **non-binding MoU giving Spice Lounge Food Works exclusive India offtake, branding and distribution of its coming food-grade emulsifier line**, about 200 tonnes a month, indicatively for five years from commissioning.
